pull_request.title: feat: swap payment processing to Stripe
pull_request.body: Replaces the mock cardNumber field with a Stripe-style payment flow: client-side tokenization (pm_xxx), Expiry + CVC fields, and a /api/checkout update that calls createAndConfirmPayment() and returns 402 on failure. The checkout button copy changes to 'Pay Now'. Uses a mock Stripe client for demo; real integration would set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.
